faq.q: How do I book on Blastek?
faq.a: Pick a treatment, choose a venue and a time from live availability, and confirm. You get instant confirmation — no phone calls, no waiting.

faq.q: Do I need an account to book?
faq.a: Yes — a quick sign-up lets you manage, reschedule and cancel your appointments from your account page.
Absolutely. Head to your appointments to cancel or move any upcoming booking, right up to the venue’s cancellation window.
You pay at the venue. Blastek takes nothing at the time of booking.
